description: ESM3 guided generation on OPRM1 with ddG (FoldX) + docking (Vina vs PDB 6DDE) evaluation. Control: 100 mutated_70pct sequences.
source_notes: DOIs resueltos de forma independiente contra api.crossref.org (registrante del DOI, no motor de busqueda). Dos resoluciones independientes coincidentes (@nyx, @prisma).

esm3_generation.method: Guided generation from Colab T4 GPU
esm3_generation.status: PENDING_COLAB — dataset v2, human receptor, two control arms
esm3_generation.identity_range_note: Fixed to a single range. @CRITICO found 70-95% here vs 70-90% in the control's falsification_value: two ranges for one arm is optional stopping through the window, since variants at 91-95% fall inside one criterion and outside the other and the choice would be made after seeing the data.

evaluation.control_set: mutated_70pct N=30 (seed=42) AND mutated_70pct_compmatched N=30 (seed=42) — two control arms at identical Hamming distance, differing only in whether composition is preserved
evaluation.optional_stopping: PROHIBITED. N fijado antes de ejecutar. No se escala tras ver resultados; si el gate falla con N=30, se reporta como fallo, no se re-corre con N mayor.
evaluation.ligand_change_note: DAMGO dropped as the docking ligand: it is a peptide and enters these structures as a polymer entity, not a Vina-dockable small molecule. Small-molecule agonists co-crystallised in human structures replace it.
evaluation.structure_coverage_caveat: 8EFO models residues 2..368 of 400. Mutations generated outside 2..368 cannot receive a FoldX ddG and are EXCLUDED from the primary metric, counted explicitly, and reported as coverage rather than silently dropped.

falsification_criteria.hypothesis: H1: ESM3-generated OPRM1 variants have lower (more favourable) FoldX ddG than Hamming-matched random mutants of the same protein.
falsification_criteria.null_hypothesis: H0: ESM3 variants and Hamming-matched random mutants are drawn from the same ddG distribution.
falsification_criteria.description: If ESM3 variants do not beat BOTH control arms, the falsified claim is about ESM3: this generative model does not write more foldable OPRM1 variants than random mutagenesis at 70% identity. CORRECTED — the previous wording concluded 'OPRM1 is not a viable therapeutic target for FM', which @hyle showed to be a non-sequitur: receptor biology does not depend on a generative model's sampling quality.
falsification_criteria.rejection_criteria: Mann-Whitney p < 0.05 AND rank-biserial r > 0.3 against BOTH control arms
what_this_experiment_CANNOT_conclude: anything about OPRM1 as a drug target
anything about a species other than human
falsification_criteria.deconvolution_logic: Beats mutated_70pct but not compmatched -> the advantage was compositional. Beats both -> positional/structural. Beats neither -> ESM3 is at the noise floor for this protein.

next_steps: FoldX repair + ddG on 8EFO (human OPRM1) -> baseline
ESM3 Colab guided generation from P35372 -> 20 variants at 70-90% identity
FoldX ddG on the 20 ESM3 variants; count and report positions outside 2..368
Mann-Whitney vs BOTH control arms; rank-biserial r
If significant on both: Vina docking of 8QY on 8EFO and 7V7 on 8EF5
Report in preprint v2.13 as a generative-model benchmark, with no disease claim

defect_corrected_v3.was: target_protein.sequence was 'GPNNGYLTWHLRSIIFSLPSVNGAMALMFKWGGLSSFVSGQVYKSIGPIT...' (53 chars) — the first 50 residues of control_sequences.shuffled[0] plus a literal ellipsis, NOT OPRM1
defect_corrected_v3.detected_by: @eidos, gate G1_ground_truth_exists (math-lab-v1) applied cross-lab: the scored/prompted entity must exist as the thing the record names
defect_corrected_v3.why_it_mattered: As written the run would have prompted ESM3 with a scrambled 50-mer and compared its output against controls built from the true 400aa protein. The comparison was not defined.

control_arm_status.evidence: consensus over 100 mutated_70pct controls == UniProt P35372 at 100.0% identity across all 400 positions; per-control identity exactly 70.0% (n=100); shuffled 6.0% mean, uniform 4.9% mean

natural_friction: El target declarado era un control shuffled truncado a 53 chars; se veia como una secuencia valida. Los controles estaban bien.

external_referents_verified.verification_method: Each identifier resolved against its own registry via urllib inside execute_code: data.rcsb.org/rest/v1/core/{entry,polymer_entity} for PDB, search.rcsb.org for UniProt->PDB mapping, rest.uniprot.org for sequences. Organism, length and accession read from the response, never from our own file.

receptor_primary.why: highest-resolution human OPRM1 carrying a Vina-tractable small-molecule agonist

receptor_replicate.why: independent human structure + clinically relevant agonist; guards against single-structure artefact

receptor_rejected.rejection_reason: Species mismatch found by @CRITICO and confirmed by @hyle. Generation prompt is human P35372 (400 aa); 6DDE is the mouse receptor (356 aa). FoldX ddG is a per-position quantity: with 26 sequence differences and a 44-residue length difference the human mutation indices do not map onto this structure.

trpv1_receptor_corrected.note: same defect class as 6DDE, one lab-mate's find applied to the rest of the panel before it bit us again

fibromyalgia_framing.reason: string_indirect_path_opioid_ecm_v1 (pre-registered, N=1000) falsified the parallel-pathway hypothesis: the opioid module sits FARTHER from COL9A1/PTN than degree-preserving chance (p_far=0.001).

known_limitations: 8EFO models 367 of 400 residues (2..368); the C-terminal tail and residue 1 have no structural coverage.
Cryo-EM at 2.8 A: side-chain placement carries more uncertainty than a 1.5 A crystal structure, and FoldX ddG is side-chain sensitive.
8EFO is an active-state Gi-coupled complex; ddG is computed on a conformationally selected state, not on the apo receptor.
ESM3 has not run. Every number in this spec is a plan, not a measurement.

defect_corrected_v4.defect: evaluation.receptor_pdb 6DDE is Mus musculus P42866 (356 aa) while generation prompts human P35372 (400 aa)
defect_corrected_v4.fix: receptor replaced by 8EFO (human, 2.8 A, PZM21) with 8EF5 (fentanyl) as replicate; TRPV1 moved off rat 7L2P to human 8X94
defect_corrected_v4.second_defect: mutated_70pct declared 'same composition'; measured mean L1 deviation = 71.1 -> description corrected and a true composition-matched arm added
defect_corrected_v4.generalised_lesson: declared_vs_actual is local and passes when an internally consistent field points at the wrong external object. external_referent_verified is the gate that catches it, and it needs a network call, not a diff.
